evidence.quote: The increasing use of data analytics, automation and artificial intelligence across digital platforms is further reshaping how consumers discover, evaluate and engage with brands.

Despite our efforts to protect the security of our information systems, cybercriminals have increasingly demonstrated advanced capabilities, such as use of zero-day vulnerabilities and rapid integration of new technology such as generative artificial intelligence.
